'''Rootleaf''' was a [[Plant/Legends|plant]] native to [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] that [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] used in a [[Rootleaf stew/Legends|stew]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|III|109|rootleaf}}</ref>
